component.name: GoveeHome
component.summary: Control Govee lights and sync them with your screen

description.p: A desktop app for Govee LED strips, TV backlights, lamps and bulbs. Lights on your network are found automatically and controlled directly over the LAN, without the cloud.

ul.li: Power, brightness, colour and white temperature
Screen sync: lights follow the colours on your screen, per segment on DreamView capable lights
Works on Wayland (GNOME, KDE Plasma) and X11
Optional Govee cloud API key for lights without LAN control and for scenes

description.p: This is an independent project and is not affiliated with Govee.
